summary: 免疫记忆可被表达为异质细胞状态的分化、由暴露历史持续改变的响应能力，以及具有空间位置但保有可塑性的组织驻留群体。检索到的三篇综述支持这些组织结构；主要未决张力是特异性与广泛训练、持久性与可塑性、局部保护与免疫病理之间的关系。

artifacts.note: 本阶段整理的学科结构和开放张力；结构来自来源摘要，张力为综合解释。
实际获取的 PubMed 摘要摘录、链接、访问日期及内容记录。

evidence: 观测到的来源内容：Kaech 与 Cui (2012) 综述指出 CD8 效应与记忆 T 细胞存在多种类型，并在表型、功能、位置和进入长期记忆池的命运上不同。
观测到的来源内容：Netea 等 (2016) 综述描述 trained immunity，可由持续的表观遗传重编程及生理改变介导，且不依赖永久遗传改变。
观测到的来源内容：Strobl 与 Haniffa (2023) 综述讨论皮肤 TRM 的异质性、形成、寿命、可塑性、逆向迁移及其在稳态和疾病中的作用。
claims: 解释性综合：可将免疫记忆建模为状态分布、历史依赖响应规则及空间分布三种互补组织原则，而非单一机制。
解释性综合：三组开放张力可作为后续跨领域构思的概念输入；本阶段不主张这些结构或张力本身具有新颖性。
limitations: 来源限于三篇可访问的 PubMed 摘要，本阶段不是系统综述；摘要信息不足以比较不同组织或实验范式中的机制细节。
开放张力是根据摘要做出的综合问题表达，并非三篇来源逐字提出的研究问题。
未开展实验、定量分析或跨领域 idea 筛选，亦未评估可行性或新颖性。
next_actions: 将三类结构及其假设交给综合阶段，作为免疫学输入而非预先筛选的候选 idea。
若后续 idea 依赖某个免疫机制的具体边界，再检索其原始研究并核对组织、细胞类型与刺激条件。

structures.name: Memory as a differentiated family of states
structures.relation: Infection produces multiple effector and memory CD8 T-cell types that vary in phenotype, function, location, and long-term fate; explain distributions and transitions rather than a single binary state switch.
assumptions: State categories are useful summaries of heterogeneous cells.
Observed phenotype and location need not uniquely determine future fate.

sources.title: Transcriptional control of effector and memory CD8+ T cell differentiation
sources.content_note: PubMed abstract read; review states that multiple effector and memory types vary in phenotype, function, location, and long-term contribution to the memory pool.

structures.name: Memory as persistent history-dependent response capacity
structures.relation: Prior exposure can persistently alter innate-cell gene expression and physiology through epigenetic reprogramming, shifting later responses without permanent genetic change or adaptive receptor rearrangement.
assumptions: The altered state persists long enough to influence a later challenge.
Functional use of memory does not imply the same specificity mechanism as adaptive clonal memory.

sources.title: Trained immunity: A program of innate immune memory in health and disease
sources.content_note: PubMed abstract read; review describes trained immunity and sustained epigenetic changes in gene expression and cell physiology, distinct from permanent genetic change.

structures.name: Memory as spatially situated but plastic
structures.relation: Tissue-resident memory supports rapid local responses, yet its cells are heterogeneous and may vary in longevity, plasticity, and migration; residence is a spatial organization principle, not necessarily irreversible confinement.
assumptions: Tissue position affects encounters and response timing.
Resident describes a state or tendency and does not by itself establish permanent confinement.

sources.title: Functional heterogeneity of human skin-resident memory T cells in health and disease
sources.content_note: PubMed abstract read; review covers TRM heterogeneity, longevity, plasticity, retrograde migration, homeostasis, and disease.

open_tensions: How should specificity be represented when later protection can be clone/antigen-linked, cross-reactive, or a broad trained response, and what distinguishes recurrent-threat recognition from a generally shifted response threshold?
How can persistence be reconciled with plasticity and migration: must durable memory preserve stable cell identity, or can it persist as a changing population or distributed physiological state?

The same memory architecture can support rapid protection and contribute to allergy, autoimmunity, inflammation, or malignancy. Which features make local readiness protective in one context and damaging in another, and at what spatial or temporal scale should this be described?
